case_requirements: goal must not be hardcoded in runtime
target resource or expected solution must not be named in prompt
AURA must select or refine the goal itself from the presented gap
record timestamped cognitive and action traces
introduce a material condition change after the first plan
verify the action outcome externally or by an independent observable
repeat after failure/change and measure the second attempt
record whether a language model participated in the decision
preserve failures and lessons between attempts
